description: Machine-readable provenance record for every input file consumed by the Rosetta demo pipeline. Regenerate with: python scripts/validate_manifest.py --regen

files.description: SQLite database containing the official Build with DataHub Agent Hackathon healthcare sample data. Four physical tables and three normalisation views. Rosetta opens this file read-only and never writes to it.
files.source_dataset: Official Build with DataHub Agent Hackathon sample data
files.transformations_applied: None. Rosetta issues read-only SELECT queries. No INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL statements are executed against this file.

files.description: Downstream lineage graph used by the seed demo (active_user / revenue / arr scenario). Maps asset URNs to lists of downstream asset URNs, mirroring the DataHub lineage API response shape. Not used by the healthcare demo — the healthcare demo uses the _DOWNSTREAM dict in rosetta/healthcare_source.py.

record_counts.note: Excludes the _comment key. All URNs reference fictional Snowflake / Looker / Tableau / mlflow assets.

files.transformations_applied: Loaded into memory by RosettaDataHub._lineage_cache. No mutation.

files.description: Ten metric definitions for the seed demo (active_user, revenue, conversion_rate, arr, customer_churn, attrition, customer_ltv) representing how different business teams define the same SaaS metrics. Not used by the healthcare demo.
files.transformations_applied: Deserialized into MetricDefinition objects by RosettaDataHub.harvest_metric_definitions(). No mutation of the source file.
